root_cause: Main intentionally promoted public-page visibility to an unconditional browser safety check, but fast-terminal regression tests still asserted the previous high-risk-only contract. This made unrelated backend/security candidates fail BRAIN on a stale oracle.
prevention_rule: When a safety gate is strengthened on canonical main, its historical replay must be updated in the same lineage. Public visibility is universal for previewed website candidates; header-menu crawl and broad browser suites remain high-risk scoped.
